editor.roleProfileHint: Sets this person's default capabilities by operational responsibility — never a raw permission list.

roleProfileDescription.ADMIN: Full system administration — users, permissions, integrations, all data.
roleProfileDescription.GENERAL_MANAGER: Broad operational visibility across brands, countries and campaigns — not system configuration.
roleProfileDescription.OPERATIONS_MANAGER: Monitors campaign progress, content and logistics workflows; not an administrator.
roleProfileDescription.LOGISTICS: Fulfils shipments — address, courier, tracking and logistics issues for their assigned countries.
roleProfileDescription.INFLUENCER_MANAGER: Manages creator relationships, campaign participation and content for their assigned countries.
roleProfileDescription.VIEWER: Read-only access within whatever scopes are granted.

capabilitiesTab.intro: Default follows the Role Profile above. Grant or Revoke sets an explicit override for this person only.

countriesTab.unrestricted: Unrestricted — this person sees every country.
countriesTab.scoped: Scoped to {count, plural, one {# country} other {# countries}}.

brandsTab.unrestricted: Unrestricted — this person sees every brand.
brandsTab.scoped: Scoped to {count, plural, one {# brand} other {# brands}}.
